_comment: Verified bibliography for paper/RKNP_SUBMISSION_FINAL_RU.docx. Metadata carried over unchanged from the verified master paper paper/APA7_PAPER_RU.md (reference audit: paper/APA7_PAPER_RU_STATUS.md, commit 2158fe8). Reformatted from APA 7 author-date into the sequential numbered style required by РКНП. No DOI is invented: entries without a DOI in the master carry none here. Numbers are assigned automatically by first appearance in the report body.
